labs.title: Expense tracker by category
labs.brief: Group expenses by category, total them, and print a sorted report.
labs.objective: Practise HashMap/TreeMap aggregation and formatted totals.

labs.title: Command-line to-do list
labs.brief: Implement add, done and list commands for an in-memory task list.
labs.objective: Practise List operations, index handling and loop-driven menus.

tests.name: add done list
tests.stdin:
add buy milk
add call mom
done 1
list
end

hints: Track done flags in a parallel List<Boolean> or a Task class.

labs.brief: Print each student's letter grade and the class average.
labs.objective: Practise classes, records and formatted output.

Aman: A

labs.title: Multi-account bank
labs.brief: Open accounts, deposit, withdraw and print balances.
labs.objective: Practise encapsulation across several objects and command parsing.

tests.name: two accounts
tests.stdin:
open 1
open 2
deposit 1 100
deposit 2 50
balance 2
end

hints: Map<Integer, Account> keyed by account id.
Validate withdrawals inside the Account class.

labs.title: Library catalogue search
labs.brief: Add titles, search by keyword and count the catalogue.
labs.objective: Practise lists, case-insensitive search and string handling.

tests.name: find and count
tests.stdin:
add Clean Code
add Effective Java
find Java
count
end

tests.name: no match
tests.stdin:
add Clean Code
find Python
count
end

labs.title: Word frequency report
labs.brief: Print words by descending frequency, ties alphabetically.
labs.objective: Practise stream grouping, comparators and formatting.
hints: Sort entries by count desc, then key asc.

labs.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit table
labs.brief: Print a conversion table from start to end in steps.
labs.objective: Practise loops, arithmetic and formatted output.

labs.title: Password validator
labs.brief: Check length, digit and uppercase rules and list every violation.
labs.objective: Practise String methods and multiple conditions.

tests.name: all failures
tests.stdout:
Too short
No digit
No uppercase

hints: Print violations in the documented order.

labs.title: Palindrome sentence
labs.brief: Ignore case and spaces and decide whether the sentence reads the same backwards.
labs.objective: Practise StringBuilder and normalisation.

labs.title: Prime sieve
labs.brief: Print all primes up to n with the sieve of Eratosthenes.
labs.objective: Practise arrays, nested loops and boolean flags.
hints: Start with every number assumed prime.
Mark multiples of each prime as composite.

labs.title: GCD and LCM calculator
labs.brief: Print the greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two numbers.
labs.objective: Practise loops, modulo and long arithmetic.
hints: lcm = a / gcd * b to avoid overflow.

labs.title: Matrix calculator
labs.brief: Add or multiply two n×n matrices based on the operation.
labs.objective: Practise 2D arrays, nested loops and command input.
hints: Multiplication needs a third loop over the shared dimension.

labs.title: Generate binary strings
labs.brief: Print every binary string of length n in lexicographic order using recursion.
labs.objective: Practise recursive backtracking.
hints: Append '0', recurse, then append '1' and recurse.
Print when the prefix length equals n.

labs.title: Contact book
labs.brief: Add contacts, look one up by name and list them sorted.
labs.objective: Practise TreeMap put/get and iteration.

tests.name: find and list
tests.stdin:
add Aman 123
add Ravi 456
find Aman
list
end

hints: find prints the phone or not found.

labs.title: Shopping cart total
labs.brief: Add items with quantity and price, then print the cart total.
labs.objective: Practise object modelling and double arithmetic.

tests.name: two items
tests.stdin:
add pen 2 10
add book 1 50
total
end

labs.title: Sales revenue report
labs.brief: Aggregate revenue per product and print it sorted with 2 decimals.
labs.objective: Practise stream grouping and summingDouble.
hints: Multiply units by price before grouping.

labs.title: CSV summary with file I/O
labs.brief: Write rows to a CSV file, read them back and report the row count and top score.
labs.objective: Practise Files.writeString/readAllLines and try-with-resources discipline.
hints: Build the CSV text with a StringBuilder.
Track the best row while parsing.

labs.title: Threaded sum of squares
labs.brief: Split the array across four threads and print the combined sum of squares.
labs.objective: Practise threads, joins and safe result collection.
hints: Give each thread a slice of the array.
Sum per-thread results after join(), or use AtomicLong.

labs.title: Generic stack
labs.brief: Implement a generic stack and run push/pop/peek/size commands on strings.
labs.objective: Practise generic classes and ArrayDeque.

tests.name: push pop size
tests.stdin:
push a
push b
pop
size
end

hints: pop on the head keeps LIFO order.

labs.title: Quiz scoring engine
labs.brief: Compare given answers with the correct ones and print the score.
labs.objective: Practise string comparison, loops and simple class design.
